title: Cybersecurity Series 5 - Business Email Compromise
location: Online
description: Business Email Compromise (BEC) is one of the most common cyber scams targeting small businesses. Attackers impersonate owners, vendors, and employees to trick staff into sharing sensitive information, buying gift cards, or sending money. These messages often look legitimate, arrive at the busiest times, and exploit everyday workflows like invoicing, payroll, and vendor payments. This webinar will walk through real-world examples and practical strategies to help you prevent, detect, and respond to BEC.

title: Free Nonprofit Workshop
location: The Joy Center, Spearfish
description: THURSDAY June 11 Mission in Action: Strategies for Planning, Executing, and Evaluating Effective Programs Who is this for? Nonprofit staff and leadership at all levels! Great programs don’t just happen, they’re created with thoughtful planning, clear execution, and evaluation. This interactive workshop walks nonprofit professionals through the entire program journey, from the initial idea all the way to measuring results, by using real-life examples and collaborative activities. Participants will engage in both individual and group exercises that help them apply practical strategies to their own programs. By working together and reflecting on real challenges, attendees will learn how to: Create clear, goal-aligned program plans Improve implementation with simple, effective processes Use data to evaluate impact and tell their program’s story Find ways to strengthen, sustain, and grow their work Use helpful tools and templates to boost program success The focus is on real-world application, so you’ll leave with practical next steps, ready-to-use resources, and greater confidence in running programs that make a meaningful, measurable difference. As always these workshops are FREE to attend and lunch is provided.

fees: ** Admission Registration Form Required to Enter - Admission is Free** Every Adult is required to complete a Registration Form and Liability Waiver before entering Responsible Dog Owner Day.  A Registration Form and Liability Waiver must be filled out by a parent/guardian for all children under 18 years of age. Responsible Dog Owner Day  Rules of the Road For all participants safety and enjoyment at Responsible Dog Owner Day, we do have a few rules that we ask everyone to follow. If your pet gets nervous around large crowds or does not interact well with people or other pets or is not a social pet, please leave them home. Please clean up after your pet (bags provided). Failure to do so will result in immediate removal from the event. Refunds will not be provided. Unruly participants will be asked to leave. Pets must be wearing a collar with proper ID at all times. Pets must be up-to-date on all vaccinations. No dogs in any stage of heat may participate. No puppies under four months of age may attend. Water for dogs is served community-style; if your dog requires a separate drinking container, please bring your own. No children 12 and under are permitted to participate without an adult. No bicycles, skateboards, roller-blades, or roller skates are allowed in the event. Interested in being a Vendor or Volunteer? description: Rakish brings Celtic and American roots music to The Matthews with the kind of playing that honors tradition and still feels alive. title: Theater on the Run
location: Various
description: A Progressive Theater Experience in Downtown Spearfish September 5 & 12 at 6:00 PM. Theater on the Run is not your typical night at the theater. This progressive performance takes you through downtown Spearfish, where you’ll visit different local businesses. At each location, enjoy a short play performed by local actors—each with its own flair, humor, and drama. TOTR is a fun a unique way to experience theater, which has made it one of our most popular events each year. A limited number of tickets are available, and the event has quickly sold out since 2012, so make sure to get yours early. This event is one you won’t want to miss! Tickets are only sold at The Matthews or online and must be purchased in advance. The participating venues are NOT selling tickets. A special Theater Running in Place performance will be held at the Opera House on Sunday, September 13th at 2 pm, where all acts will be performed on one stage.

location: High Plains Western Heritage Center
description: Hearty chuckwagon dinner, great comedy and classic cowboy music. Ticket includes admission to the museum so come early! You’ll enjoy beef tips and all the fixin’s, including homemade dessert, created by ol’ Cookie himself, Dave Brueckner, and his crew at Cheyenne Crossing. After dinner, make your way into the Bruce Miller Theater for a 45-minute Western-style comedy music show that will delight you with dazzling harmonies and family-friendly entertainment.
